create_anthropic_backend: create an Anthropic backend instance with a model name and optional client arguments
get_chat_template_claude: get the Claude chat template used to format messages for the Anthropic API
generate_completion: generate a text completion from a message list or raw text using the Anthropic backend
generate_stream_completion: generate a streaming text completion from a message list or raw text using the Anthropic backend
convert_sampling_params: convert SglSamplingParams to Anthropic API keyword arguments for the messages.create call
